summary: Implemented the show_speed feature in rich/progress.py: TaskProgressColumn gained a show_speed option and a static render_speed method, track() gained a show_speed parameter (default True), and Progress.track no longer raises for unsized iterables with no total. Added a CHANGELOG entry and test_task_progress_column_speed, and removed the ValueError assertions from test_track and test_progress_track. Not verified: I did not run pytest, mypy, or black, per the instructions, so the strict-mypy and black checks are unconfirmed. Nothing was committed.
